add.title: Outright International: Mozambique country page
add.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. Outright's Mozambique overview (updated March 2026) covers decriminalised same-sex conduct (2015 penal code), absence of any legal gender-recognition procedure, and social barriers for LGBTIQ people, but contains no information on where transgender prisoners are housed, no placement rule, and no documented custody case involving a trans person.

add.title: Mozambique: Events of 2023 (HRW World Report 2024)
add.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. The HRW World Report 2024 Mozambique chapter (published 11 Jan 2024) documents general police detentions and election-related arrests but contains no transgender-specific content and no prison-placement information for trans prisoners.
